        f[i] = (f[i] + f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % M * C[i - 1][j - 1] % M * (i + 1)) % M

            s += abs(k - j)

                 s * f[j - 1] % M * f[i - j] % M * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % M

fd[0][0] = 1

    for j in range(0, min(m, i) + 1):
        fd[i][j] = fd[i - 1][j]

            val_d = d[i - 1][j - k] if i - 1 >= 0 else 0
            fd[i][j] = (fd[i][j] + val_fd * f[k] % M * C[j][k]) % M
            d[i][j] = (d[i][j] + ((val_fd * dp[k] + val_d * f[k]) % M * C[j][k]) ) % M

print((d[n][m] % M + M) % M)
